question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**under**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "put the prairies and grasslands under the plow" refers to cultivating or farming the land, which is a common expression used to describe plowing or turning the soil for agricultural purposes.
 
• "Under" is the most appropriate choice because it suggests the action of the plow going over and turning the soil beneath it.
 
• Other options ("besides", "above", "on top") do not convey the correct meaning in this agricultural context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Erosion of America's farmland by wind and water (1)_____ a problem since settlers first put the prairies and grasslands (2) under__ the plow in the 19th century. By the 1930s, more than 282 million acres of farmland were (3)______ by erosion. After 40 years of conservation efforts, soil erosion has (4)________ due to new demands placed (5)____ the land by heavy crop production.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Under" correctly reflects the meaning of the land being worked or cultivated with a plow, which is the intended sense of the passage.
 
• "Besides", "above", and "on top" do not fit the context of the land being worked or cultivated in a farming sense.
